pin_note: Drift alarm pins (REQ-61): every marker below must appear in the fetched bytes. If nfl.com renames sections, drops tables, or serves a JS-only shell, the run fails loudly (exit 2) instead of publishing a blank. Markers were observed in the rendered page on 2026-11-15 and in typical nfl.com raw HTML.

injury_report.note: If raw HTML proves to be a JS-only shell (markers absent), the alarm fires and the decision to add a rendering step is logged — never a silent blank.
